# Awesome iOS for Agents

> Catalog of iOS open-source libraries with objective data (stars, release, last commit, min iOS, Swift tools version, Swift language mode) and a computed top pick per category.

Data date: 2026-11-04. Machine-readable data: https://github.com/jeffy-w/awesome-ios-for-agents/raw/main/catalog.json

Rules: last activity = latest GitHub release date; for repos with no GitHub release, the last commit date on the default branch. Status: active < 365 days, slowing < 730 days, inactive otherwise, or archived. Rank: within a category, entries with status active or slowing that are not add-ons (addon_of) are sorted by stars, highest first; rank 1 is the top pick. Categories with ranked=false (provider-specific SDKs) are not ranked. Package.swift: min_ios, swift_tools and products are read from Package.swift at the latest release tag; if that tag is not a version number, at the highest version tag among the latest 100 tags; otherwise at the default branch. package_swift_at names the ref used. Swift language mode (swift_mode, Swift 6.4.2): language mode of the targets an app links (targets of library products and the package targets they depend on; every regular and executable target when there is no library product), from `swift package dump-package` with the Swift version in swift_version, so the version-specific manifest that Swift picks is used. Only targets with .swift files count; "none" = no such target (ObjC/C library); null = no Package.swift or it could not be read. Settings limited to a build configuration or trait do not count toward strict_concurrency. "6" = all in Swift 6 mode, "5" = none, "6/5" = mixed. strict_concurrency = true when every target left in Swift 5 mode enables complete strict concurrency checking. A package's own mode does not change your app's mode; it shows whether the library's API was checked for data races. Issue replies (issues): share of issues answered by maintainers: issues (not pull requests) opened in issue_window (12 months ending 30 days before the data date) by people outside the project, latest 100 per repo (issues_sampled counts those by outside people). Answered = a maintainer other than the author commented, or a person other than the author closed it; bots do not count. Maintainers = OWNER, MEMBER or COLLABORATOR, plus anyone who closed, labeled or assigned someone else's issue. issue_response is null when fewer than 5 issues were sampled (see issues_sampled and issues_answered) or issues are disabled (issues_enabled=false). Shown for information; not used for rank. issue_window: 2025-10-05 to 2026-10-05. Stale values (marked *): a value that cannot be read in a refresh keeps the last value read: swift_mode_checked and issues_checked give the date it was read, swift_mode_error and issues_error say why this refresh failed, and stale lists the fields whose value is older than generated. Kind: library = can be added as an app dependency; tool = developer tool or build plugin, never an app library dependency
